name: 9-nine- Shinshou
source: This is a standalone version of the "New Episode" chapter added in 9-nine- Complete Edition (r74265). The new episode ties up the loose ends from the previous 4 chapters, and contains after stories for each heroine (the scenario part totals about 230kb). It contains 10 CGs.
translation: 这是9-9- 完整版 (r74265) 中添加的“新剧集”章节的独立版本。新的剧集弥补了前四章的未完成部分，并包含了每位女主角的后续故事（剧情部分总计约230kb）。包含10张CG。
